threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's weird when a bus doesn't have the right number displayed. Welcome to the real London where that’s just Tuesday.
Last night on the 36, a bloke was trying to sell a pair of mismatched trainers. Said they were 'one of a kind'. The driver just laughed.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard the U-Bahn announce a 'Warte auf den Fahrgast' delay while a busker played Beethoven on the corner. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see spontaneous techno parties in abandoned buildings, complete with a makeshift bar and a crowd that just happens to have glow sticks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their patience waiting for the 14 bus; they know better than to believe the schedule in the rain.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy arguing with a pigeon at Civic Center last week. Only in SF does a bird get as much attention as the transit delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can master 'Català' in a week, but locals switch to Spanish out of habit. It’s like speaking a different language altogether.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they hesitantly pay for their coffee, fumbling with coins instead of just using a card.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you're new if you still call it a 'night out' instead of a 'night in' at a pub that's actually a cafe.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the whole bus with Elvis songs. Only in Brixton can a late-night ride feel like a mini concert.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy selling homemade jam out of a crate on Karl-Marx-Strasse, chatting with folks like they were old friends.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you have spontaneous parties in the U-Bahn after a big soccer match. You might find a full-on rave between Warschauer Straße and Schönhauser Allee.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local if they can name all the taco trucks but still complain about the endless Muni delays from 'that dog on the tracks.'

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni today just after the dog incident at Civic Center. The driver joked it was the first pup to hold up the route this week.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just Gaudí and hipster bars, but the real charm is in the little squares where old folks play dominoes and share gossip.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their fascination with every single street performer in Plaça del Sol while locals just walk past without a glance.
